Junior Year in Valencia Located in the heart of Valencia,
Uni-Valencia offers immersive language mornings and
cultural afternoons.
Explore stunning architecture, vibrant heritage, and the
Albufera Natural Park—one of Europe’s most important
wetlands with breathtaking views and a unique ecosystem.
This program blends academic rigor with unforgettable
experiences.
